newsitem.title: YEMEN: Yemen calls on U.N. to halt Israeli housing plan.
newsitem.headline: Yemen calls on U.N. to halt Israeli housing plan.

text.p: Yemen on Thursday slammed Israel's decision to build homes for Jews in Arab East Jerusalem as a serious blow to the Middle East peace process and urged U.N. action to stop the plan.

"Israel's decision to build a new neighbourhood in occupied East Jerusalem is a new escalation aimed at creating tension in the region, and an expression of intentions to destroy the peace process," Yemen's foreign ministry said in a statement broadcast by state television.

"Yemen urges the (United Nations) Security Council and all parties interested in peace ... especially the United States and Europe to exert pressure on Israel to reverse this decision," the statment added.
Israel on Wednesday said it would build 6,500 houses for Jews in Jabal Abu Ghneim or Har Homa.
Israel says all of Jerusalem is its capital. Palestinians consider Arab East Jerusalem, which Israel seized during the 1967 Middle East war, the capital of a future Palestinian state.
